events.title: U.S. Wholesale Inventories Climb More Than Expected In September
events.description: Wholesale inventories in the U.S. increased by more than expected in the month of September, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Monday. The Commerce Department said wholesale inventories climbed by 0.7 percent in September after rising by an upwardly revised 0.6 percent in August.

events.title: Jobs-led Rate Hike Worries Push Dollar Higher
events.description: The U.S. Dollar extended gains against major currencies during the week ended November 6 amidst a massive spike in non-farm payrolls in the U.S. The better-than-expected jobs data increased the headroom available to the Federal Reserve to raise rates, bolstering the greenback. The payrolls-driven rally more than offset the dollar's decline that followed the midterm election results.

events.title: Canadian Market Likely To Open On Positive Note
events.description: Higher Canadian and U.S. futures combined with firm precious metals prices signal a positive start for Canadian equities Monday. Oil prices declined following remarks by U.S. President Donald Trump that renewed military strikes on Iran were "highly unlikely."

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls As European Shares Trade Higher
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday, as the region's stocks traded higher heading into a high-stakes week defined by speeches from a slew of European Central Bank officials, the release of U.S. inflation prints, and the latest third quarter growth estimates from many countries that could influence expectations for monetary policy.

events.title: FTSE 100 Climbs Higher As Miners Post Strong Gains
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 climbed higher on Monday, lifted by strong gains in the mining sector. Weak crude oil prices and softening bond yields boosted sentiment.

events.title: CAC 40 Climbs Higher On Corporate News, Weak Oil Prices
events.description:
France's equity benchmark CAC 40 moved higher on Monday, rebounding a bit from recent losses, as oil prices dropped and bond yields softened slightly. 

Oil prices dropped following remarks by U.S. President Donald Trump that renewed military strikes on Iran were "highly unlikely" while talks to end their eight-month-old conflict continue.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: UniCredit Lifts FY26 Profit View After Higher Q3; Plans Control Of Commerzbank; Stock Gains
events.description: Shares of UniCredit S.p.A. were gaining around 5 percent in Italian trading after the bank on Monday raised fiscal 2026 outlook after reporting strong growth in third-quarter profit and revenues. The Italian lender, which is in the process of full consolidation of Commerzbank AG, further said it is heading into 2027 with strong momentum, while confirming profit targets for fiscal 2028 and 2030.

events.title: DAX Advances As Oil Prices Drop; Commerzbank, SAP Rise On Rating Upgrade
events.description:
German stocks gained ground in positive territory Monday morning as weak oil prices and softening bond yields helped underpin sentiment. 

Oil prices dropped following remarks by U.S. President Donald Trump that renewed military strikes on Iran were "highly unlikely" while talks to end their eight-month-old conflict continue.

events.title: Indian Shares End Higher After Late-session Buying
events.description: Indian shares moved in a narrow range before ending marginally higher on Monday, tracking mixed cues from global markets.

events.title: Antipodean Currencies Rise Amid Risk-on Mood
events.description: The antipodean currencies such as the Australia and the New Zealand dollars strengthened against their major currencies in the Asian session on Monday amid risk-on mood by the investors, boosted by strong gains in Taiwan, Japan and South Korea amid a rebound in semiconductor stocks following the sell-off last week. Some traders are also looking to buy stocks at a bargain following the recent weakness. Markets also keep an eye on the ongoing peace talks to end hostilities in the Middle East.

events.title: Gold Inches Higher As Dollar Steadies After Rally
events.description: Gold prices rose toward $4,100 an ounce on Monday as the U.S. dollar stabilized after climbing on stronger-than-expected employment data.

events.title: NZ Dollar Advances Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Monday.
